entry.title: Rick Astley - Angels On My Side (Live at The O2, London, April 2026)

media:group.media:title: Rick Astley - Angels On My Side (Live at The O2, London, April 2026)
media:group.media:description:
Taken from Rick Astley’s sold-out Reflections Tour, this live performance of “Angels On My Side” was recorded at London’s O2 Arena in April 2026.
Originally featured on Rick’s chart-topping album 50, this live version of "Angels On My Side" is now included on the 10th Anniversary Deluxe Edition of 50, celebrating a decade since the album’s release.
50 (10th Anniversary Deluxe Edition) is out now via BMG.
